text_block_list.text:
Peeking into the dance studio, I saw Tokai Teio
practicing dance on her own.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
All riiight!
Time for the "Teio Step: Modified" right here~!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Spinnnnning arooouuund...
...Wait, whoaaaaa?!

Losing her balance mid-spin,
Tokai Teio ended up tumbling over.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ow, ow, ow~.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!?
If you were here, you should've said something~!
choice_data_list: Because I didn't want to get in the way.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You're not bothering me at all~!
Besides, there's something I wanted to show you!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You saw part of it earlier, right?
The "Teio Step: Kai"♪

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
After the Teio Step, lift one leg up
and spin around and around!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: It looks really cool when you pull it off, but spinning in place like that is so tough~.
choice_data_list: Let's work on your sense of balance.
Let's build up strength throughout your whole body

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, good point!
I do always end up wobbling halfway through.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"...I know! How about we ask Maruzen
to give us ballet lessons!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Senpai, your dad's a ballet dancer, right?
I bet he knows some great training routines!
choice_data_list: I can't wait to see it finished!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hehe~♪ Lord Teio's ultimate dance
is gonna captivate everyoneee!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Uuuugh!
My sense of balance got trained, but...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: More than the lesson itself, the drive with Maruzen afterward felt like the real training... maybe.

She seems exhausted from the unexpected training,
but she appears to have achieved good results.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I seeee~.
Without proper core strength, you'd just wobble around, right!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I've decided! To perfect the
"Teio Step: Modified," I'm gonna start conditioning my body right now~!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, is there a routine
that builds balanced muscle?!"
I nodded to say of course, andâ
Afterward, Tokai Teio and I worked hard together on strength training.
